notes.title: Slut Squad's demo will be participating in Steam Next Fest June 9 to 16!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621284/89aec0556c1d914cd7d0808b619697e66ea0a455.png"][/img]Hi, Bosses!  Slut Squad's [b]demo will be participating in Steam Next Fest June 9 to 16![/b] This is an important step and moment for us, so please support it if you're interested and/or curious by trying it out and wishlisting if you had fun, or by sharing it with some of your friends that might enjoy the game!

notes.title: Slut Squad is releasing a demo on Steam
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621284/fc0e6a2e18832eeb2b8566767b8d46af7caf0fe2.png"][/img]

Hi, [b]Bosses[/b]! Slut Squad is releasing a demo on Steam and will be participating in the Steam Next Fest! We fixed many bugs based on your awesome feedback, and opened more levels to play through, so come check it out, and don't forget to wishlist the game if you like it! 

Thank you for showing interest in our game and participating in its improvement — we really, really appreciate all of you!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554940/Slut_Squad?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=DemoRelease"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: We'll release a demo version of Slut Squad on Saturday!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!   
We're happy to say that [b]on Saturday at 10(AM) UTC-0 we'll release a demo version of Slut Squad. [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3554940/Slut_Squad?utm_source=Steam&utm_campaign=DemoAnnounce

Please look forward to it! Don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam to get notified the moment it goes live!

notes.title: THE SLUT SQUAD IS TAKING SHAPE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45621284/838c2cc6819a2b76bc1c1fa7c49bb20fa0d5605d.png[/img]
Hey! We're hyped to announce that the Steam page for our new game Slut Squad is now live! 🖥️💥
Come check it out and wishlist early to potentially grab some extra goodies!  💰

Slut Squad is an engaging puzzle game with merge mechanics and management sim elements. Expect lots of hot girls, each with fully animated and uncensored 18+ scenes, and a light dating mechanic.  💕

The story takes place in a city filled with crime, where you, a daring and ambitious boss of an emerging gang, will recruit the sexiest robbery pros this city has to offer and build your own criminal empire. 🏙️😎 

Want to dive deeper before launch?
Join our Discord to get the latest updates asap, sneak peeks 👀, and maybe even chat with the devs! 💬 Wishlist our game on Steam to support us and participate in a giveaway. It really means a lot to us!
